title: Chicago Union Station
exportLabel: Molen original Chicago Union Station historic headhouse and roof court
visualBrief: Whole individual above-ground Chicago Union Station historic headhouse and physically attached mapped Canal Street arcade/canopy. Preserve the separate underground concourse east of Canal, independent modern offices, public roads and surrounding buildings. Author all four exterior fronts and the actual roof/service masses after resolving the roof layout; no invented extra station platforms, copied lettering, advertising, people, trains or navigable interiors.

references.observed: Ordinary Canal/east-front photograph inspected. Pale limestone headhouse with massive lower entablature, tall rectangular lower pilasters and recessed door/window bays, horizontal stone/frieze bands, segmental-headed openings above the lower mass, stacked upper rectangular windows between tall pilasters, narrow attic windows below a projecting cornice/parapet, a raised rooftop service mass, and corner clock discs. Independent taller office buildings remain separate. No copied signs, lettering, traffic furniture, people or vehicles. This street view does not verify the whole roof plan.

July2019 Canal/Jackson corner view inspected. Canal lower pilaster front differs from the deep Jackson/southern round-column colonnade. Tall round-arched corner entries, heavy entablature, decorative banding, upper window/pilaster rhythm and twin corner clocks are visible. Hidden north/west and central roof geometry are not established. No copied lettering, adverts, cars or people.

Segmental barrel-vaulted glazed roof recessed within four surrounding office wings, visible longitudinal and transverse metal grid, lower perimeter roof terrace and inward-facing masonry/window walls. The image does not survey exact overall roof location or heights; model uses explicit picture-scale estimates.
